sources.title: Axion Monodromy and the Weak Gravity Conjecture

evidence.text: Coarse-graining the local minima produces integer-labeled vacua described by a nondynamical four-form flux. Matching vacuum energies gives e = 2πmf, and a barrier estimate gives wall tension TDW ∼ α^1/2 f. Vacuum transitions are discussed using bubble nucleation.

sources.title: Axion Monodromy and the Weak Gravity Conjecture

evidence.text: Dimensional analysis compares magnetic-brane field energy with black-brane tension, giving Λ^[2(p+1)] ≲ ep,d² Md^(d−2). Its use for four-dimensional domain walls is explicitly proposed by analytical continuation rather than derived from an actual magnetic object.

sources.title: Axion Monodromy and the Weak Gravity Conjecture

evidence.text: Dimensional reduction uses a symplectic harmonic-form basis, Kij = ∫wi∧⋆wj, and charge norm |qΣ|² = K^ij qiΣqjΣ. The F5 self-duality condition is imposed after handling electric and dual sources; the resulting normalization enters the particle/domain-wall comparison.
